messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-87321 fired for service=canary-serving-us-west-1 — symptom=canary-failure (>10% errors for 5m). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-failure

pagerduty-bot: Incident PDR-87321 assigned to schedule infer-oncall, paging maria gonzalez. Attempt 1 -> sent.

maria gonzalez: Ack — I'm on it. Thanks PD. @aj patel can you grab canary logs + tokenization stack traces?

aj patel: Acked. pulling logs now. Initial grep shows repeated tokenizer-v2 NullPointer at batch edgecases. sending sample: `ERROR tokenizer v2: null at Tokenizer.java:312`

samir rao: Seeing p95/p99 jumps on the canary fleet in us-west-1 (p99 ~ 1.9s -> 4.8s). 5xx rate ~ 12% for canary tag. Gateway indicates amplify on large-batch endpoints.

kevin li: product-sr — any confirmed customer impact?

product-sr: CS flagged one enterprise customer with batch timeouts ~08:11 UTC. Not widespread but affecting >1 API key. CS ticket #4672 opened.

maria gonzalez: Triage: Pause rollout, divert traffic away from canary region, and prepare rollback to 2.3.0 if health doesn't improve within 10m. Assigning tasks: @aj logs/debug; @samir rollback ops; @oncall-ops coordinate comms.

aj patel: Paused rollout in console -> response 200. Command used: `PATCH https://console.redwood/api/rollouts/12345 {"state":"paused"}`

pagerduty-bot: PDR-87321 acknowledged by maria gonzalez (on-call). Escalation policy will hold for 5 minutes.

aj patel: Dumping canary container logs to gist -> https://internal.gists/abc123 (redacted) — seeing tokenizer upgrade path + new quantization code in lib. Could be binary mismatch.

samir rao: Initiating pull-back to previous image now. Command: ```kubectl -n canary set image deployment/canary canary=ghcr.io/redwood/model-server:2.3.0 && kubectl rollout status deployment/canary -n canary --watch```

maria gonzalez: Running health-check script against canary instances: ```curl -sS http://canary-us-west1.healthz | jq .```
health-check output snippet: ```{"status":"degraded","checks":{"tokenizer":"fail","uptime":"12m"}}```

kevin li: Noted. I'm sending a short customer-facing blurb to CS to create a status page entry: "We are investigating increased errors affecting a subset of batch requests in us-west. Mitigation in progress."
